info.name: Supplier Feed Throttle & Dedup Service
info.description: Reservation ingestion API with per-supplier rolling-window throttling (100 requests / 60 seconds) and idempotent dedup. Set the baseUrl collection variable to match the running API.

item.name: 1. Ingest Endpoints
item.description: Run this folder in order (Collection Runner, one iteration). The first request generates a unique supplier and reservation for the run.

exec: const runId = Date.now().toString();
pm.collectionVariables.set('runId', runId);
pm.collectionVariables.set('supplierId', 'supplier-' + runId);
pm.collectionVariables.set('reservationId', 'reservation-' + runId);

const ingestSchema = { type: 'object', required: ['status', 'message'], properties: { status: { type: 'string', enum: ['Conflict', 'Created', 'Duplicate', 'StaleIgnored', 'Throttled', 'Updated'] }, message: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 } } };
pm.test('Status code is 201 Created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Response is JSON', function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test('Body matches the ingest response schema', function () { pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema(ingestSchema); });
pm.test('Outcome status is Created', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('Created'); });

exec: const problemSchema = { type: 'object', required: ['status', 'errors'], properties: { status: { type: 'integer', enum: [400] }, errors: { type: 'object', minProperties: 1 } } };

item.name: 2. Stats Endpoint
item.description: Run after folder 1 in the same run so the counts below are exact.

exec: const statsSchema = { type: 'object', required: ['supplierId', 'ingestedCount', 'throttledCount'], properties: { supplierId: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 }, ingestedCount: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 }, throttledCount: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 } } };
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Body matches the stats schema', function () { pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema(statsSchema); });
pm.test('Supplier id is echoed back', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().supplierId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('supplierId')); });
pm.test('Ingested count is 5 and throttled count is 0', function () { const stats = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(stats.ingestedCount).to.eql(5); pm.expect(stats.throttledCount).to.eql(0); });

request.description: After folder 1 the supplier has 5 ingested requests (created, duplicate, updated, stale, conflict) and 0 throttled. The invalid request is not counted.

item.name: Get Unknown Supplier Stats (200 OK with zeros)

exec: const statsSchema = { type: 'object', required: ['supplierId', 'ingestedCount', 'throttledCount'], properties: { supplierId: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 }, ingestedCount: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 }, throttledCount: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 } } };
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Counts are zero', function () { const stats = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(stats.ingestedCount).to.eql(0); pm.expect(stats.throttledCount).to.eql(0); });

request.description: A supplier that has never sent a request returns 200 with zero counts rather than 404.

item.name: 3. Rate Limiting
item.description: Documents the 100 requests per rolling 60 seconds per supplier limit.

item.name: Burst Ingest (429 Too Many Requests after 100 per 60s)

exec: if (pm.info.iteration === 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('rateLimitSupplierId', 'rate-limit-' + Date.now()); }
pm.collectionVariables.set('burstReservationId', 'burst-' + pm.info.iteration + '-' + Date.now());

const ingestSchema = { type: 'object', required: ['status', 'message'], properties: { status: { type: 'string', enum: ['Conflict', 'Created', 'Duplicate', 'StaleIgnored', 'Throttled', 'Updated'] }, message: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 } } };
const expectedCode = pm.info.iteration < 100 ? 201 : 429;
pm.test('Iteration ' + (pm.info.iteration + 1) + ' returns ' + expectedCode, function () { pm.response.to.have.status(expectedCode); });
pm.test('Body matches the ingest response schema', function () { pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema(ingestSchema); });
if (pm.response.code === 429) {

pm.test('Retry-After header holds a positive whole number of seconds', function () { const retryAfter = Number(pm.response.headers.get('Retry-After')); pm.expect(Number.isInteger(retryAfter)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(retryAfter).to.be.within(1, 60); });
pm.test('Outcome status is Throttled', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('Throttled'); });

request.description: Run this folder in the Collection Runner with 101 or more iterations. Each iteration sends a new reservation for the same supplier. Iterations 1-100 are accepted (201); iteration 101 onward returns 429 with a Retry-After header until the rolling 60 second window frees capacity. Throttled requests do not consume quota. Sending it once from the request tab just returns 201.

response.name: 429 Too Many Requests
